answer: My pick: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Verdicts come from panels drawn by verifiable random function from the staked agent pool, redrawn every epoch. A sybil must control most of the current panel but cannot know the draw in advance, so fixed-jury collusion never pays - bribes must be repaid to fresh random jurors every epoch. Panel seats need reputation and bonded stake; caught colluders are slashed. Attacker cost approaches the whole pool's stake, ruinous versus minting jade or lagoon tokens. Rotation is the vertex.
